title: Support absent import sentinels without conflating incomplete MSBuild properties
outcome: Support absent import sentinels without conflating incomplete MSBuild properties
acceptance: End-to-end closure requires the real late Directory.Build.targets idiom starting with an ABSENT sentinel: evaluate the guarded reference-bearing import, assign the flag to true, retain the intended dependency in the semantic result, and skip the distinct second guarded import with no unresolved-property or ordering refusal. Changing the error code or passing only a seeded/early variant does not satisfy this criterion.

The early flag-only absent-state repro successfully evaluates the import condition, records the flag assignment, and skips the distinct second guarded import, matching native MSBuild; explicit true still skips both and prior incomplete assignments are not silently converted to absent values.
